script_text: Aries, the cosmic clock is about to strike a rare chord of rebellion just for your fiery spirit this week. Monday opens with Venus sextile Jupiter in your social houses, boosting charm, but Tuesday’s Mercury square Uranus shakes your shared finances unexpectedly. Wednesday brings the Full Moon in your First House opposing the Sun, a pivotal moment forcing you to choose between partnership and your own self. By Thursday, Mars, your ruling planet, enters Capricorn in your career house, transforming lunar tension into undeniable professional authority. Weekend Venus in Scorpio deepens romance. Wednesday is your power day because the Full Moon lights your personal identity for the bright world. Tuesday is your weakest day because Mercury squaring Uranus strikes unexpected financial anxiety daily. Channel your Fire energy into long-term goals, but pause before signing any binding contract before Friday night. Follow for daily astrological updates.
